title: Math Process Framework Textbook Staleness Resolution

core_update.binding_rule: Meta-domain A/B are not affect-domain A/B. Affect-domain A/B require explicit rebinding before use.

stale_sections.issue: The textbook now canonically identifies RT itself with fixed meta-domain bindings instead of leaving the root expression implicit.
stale_sections.resolution: Insert the canonical RT binding block immediately after the Primary Axiom.

stale_sections.issue: The base-case trace was still described as open or insufficiently bottomed out.
stale_sections.resolution: Reclassify the RT base case as DEFINITION_FIXED_PROOF_PENDING.

stale_sections.issue: The family could still be read as if coupling projection were an isolated primitive.
stale_sections.resolution: Clarify that coupling projection is a family member induced through governed family instantiation rather than an independent primitive.

stale_sections.issue: Orientation was sometimes treated as upstream of RT rather than downstream of RT organization.
stale_sections.resolution: Reframe orientation as organization over admissible RT conditions.

stale_sections.issue: Several entries overstated unresolved status after recent RT campaign patches.
stale_sections.resolution: Audit the Appendix F status labels and split stale GAP_OPEN language into OPEN, REGISTERED_LATE, DOWNSTREAM_FORMALIZATION_PENDING, DEFINITION_FIXED_PROOF_PENDING, or PARENT_FAMILY_HARDENING_REQUIRED where appropriate.

implementation: Add a canonical RT/meta-domain binding block to Chapter 1.2.
Mark the RT base-case trace as DEFINITION_FIXED_PROOF_PENDING.
Reframe orientation as downstream of RT organization.
Treat tensor/coupling as a governed member of the typed meta-relation family.
Normalize Appendix F status labels so stale GAP_OPEN language is replaced with the narrower governed statuses.
acceptance_criteria: The textbook presents RT as the canonical root expression with fixed meta-domain bindings.
The RT trace base case is no longer labeled GAP_OPEN.
Orientation is presented as downstream of RT organization.
The coupling operator is not presented as an independent primitive.
Appendix F no longer uses stale GAP_OPEN status language for the affected entries.
global_validate.py reports no new validation failures caused by this patch.
notes: The patch preserves the canonical root expression while making the fixed meta-domain bindings explicit.
No duplicate mathematical registry is introduced.
The affected Appendix F entries are reclassified conservatively rather than closed wholesale.
